integrity: Analytical proof plus a standalone standard-library numerical consistency checker; no independent proof audit or historical-priority certification.
limitations: No weighted bridge, longer connecting path, arbitrary clique tree or prescribed target dimension; finite numerical checks are not an infinite proof; historical priority is not independently certified.
scientific_scope: Exact least real-Hilbert metric distortion for unweighted bridge-linked cliques of sizes m+1 and n+1, with integers m,n at least two, plus complete congruence rigidity and sharp size dependence.
title: Sharp Hilbert distortion and rigidity for bridge-linked cliques
